speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: There is dinner, and there is a question. Are you going up, or are you eating?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am eating. Thomas has the king at two. I am not going at two, and I was not there at nine.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The cap has been on since the morning. I was not going to name it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Name it if you like. I am in it because the jaw prefers a warm head to a hat in a wind. I am not in it for a part.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then eat the soft of what is here. I will not have you prove the jaw against a crust for the sake of looking ready.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not ready, and I am not proving it. Pope has nothing till the garden. He can have the garden without me in the yard to nod at him.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Gib is on the settle again. He is not on a paper. I looked before I sat.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Leave the cat. Leave the Theatre to the men who went. If they have news, the news can come when it comes. I will not have a boy sent to fetch a laugh.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No boy. If Thomas gets his laugh, I shall hear it when someone chooses to bring it. I will not spend the afternoon hungry for it.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: A man can leave a loom for a day and the cloth does not ask him where he was. I am not offering a moral. I am eating.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then eat, and do not offer it. I do not know how the king is going. Knowing the part is not knowing the afternoon.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. The board is threepence, the same as Sunday. The food is soft. That is the whole of my office today.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I will do my part of it, which is to sit, and to let two of the clock happen somewhere else.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will clear when you are done. I will not ask who died well. I do not know the play well enough to ask it decently.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Ask nothing. I could not answer a laugh today if you did ask it. The cap and the bowl are the news of this house.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: The bowl is enough. I have no question that wants Shoreditch.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Mark me. When you have eaten, you may go up and be quiet. You may not invent an errand that ends at Shoreditch.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have no errand. I have a cap. Thomas has the king.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The loaf is still a penny, and still a full thumb short of the notch. The soft side is in the bowl.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I see it. I will take the soft side, and I will not call the jaw healed because the tooth is out.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The tooth is out, and the jaw is tender, and tender is not a licence to walk. Sit until the bowl is empty.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am sitting. Yesterday's custard was the last sweet thing in the house, and I am not sending for another.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I washed the cloth. I am not carrying it back today. Nobody asked me to.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nobody will ask you today. The cloth can wait on a day when I have a fact to carry with it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then the fact can wait with the cloth. Eat the broth before it skins over.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am eating it. Two of the clock can happen without my mouth.
